description: Transactions admitted or refused by the topic manager's rules (docs/spec.md section 11.1), in the order given there. Each case is the transaction as raw hex and the BEEF submitted (Atomic BEEF unless the case says otherwise: an unmined carrier's with its funding tree, a mined sweep's with its own proof; a vault token's is BEEF V1 of its parent then the token, as the codec's TokenBEEF writes it), and the previous coins it is admitted with: the inputs that spend an output the topic holds once the admitted cases are admitted (inputIndex), each with the outpoint it spends (txid in display order). They decide what is retained and no verdict. Admission runs against the crypt and the headers below, with a BEEF bound of maxBeef bytes and a sweep input bound of maxSweepInputs unless a case names its own. A refusal is raised, never answered with empty instructions. admits lists the admittance instructions (outputsToAdmit, coinsToRetain) and what the lookup service records: a carrier's commitment (hash byte order), record, owner, content id and funding outpoint; a token's seq, record, parent txid (display order), its predecessor's seq and the outpoint its predecessor input (at seq 0, its funding input) spends; a sweep's spent outpoints. scriptsVerify says every input of the transaction passes the script interpreter against the output it spends, so each refusal is made by the rule the case names and by no earlier one. rule names the row of docs/frozen.md section 2 a refusal pins, and rows counts the refusals of each. Cases named "-before-" break two rules and are refused for the earlier. Signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979). stored is each admitted token of the vault as the engine stores it, the token alone with its proof, read without its parent and held to the token before it by its spend; a replayer assembles replayBeef from two stored tokens (at seq 0, the token and its chain tree), byte for byte the BEEF the token was first admitted in.
